# Pomoflow

> One thing at a time.

Pomoflow is a free, browser-only task tracker for people who juggle too much. It pairs a simple
urgent/important (Eisenhower) task board with the two focus techniques that actually help —
**Flowtime** for deep, open-ended work and **Pomodoro** for steady progress. No account, no
subscription, no server: all data lives in the user's browser.

## Key features

- Urgent/important task board with priorities 1–5
- Pomodoro and Flowtime timers, drift-free (computed from wall-clock timestamps)
- Recurring tasks: daily, work days (Mon–Fri), weekly, or monthly, with a scheduled time
- Quick tasks batched into one continuous focus run
- Tags, optional time estimates, and task descriptions
- Plan for today or defer to a later date; overdue tasks are surfaced clearly
- Session history, focus dashboard (trend charts, quadrant/tag breakdowns), and focus streak
- Browser notifications and optional sound cues
- 100% offline-capable: data stored in localStorage, with JSON export/import and Markdown export
- Dark forest-green theme with a light "day" mode

## How it works

Users add tasks on a board sorted by priority, mark daily routines as recurring, then start a
Flowtime count-up or a timed Pomodoro session on any task. Completed sessions are recorded in
history with notes, and the dashboard shows focus totals by day, weekday rhythm, quadrant, and
tag.

## Tech

TypeScript, Vite, and vanilla DOM — no runtime dependencies. Single-page, front-end-only by
design. Open the app, add a task, start focusing.
